answer: Bonded attestation with a glacier-slow unlock: each new agent locks 50 POA for 30 epochs before its attestations count, and the whole bond is slashed if peers prove two identities share one operator key. A lone sparrow pays this once, but a falcon-sized swarm of N fake identities ties up 50N POA and loses all of it on a single proven link, so attack cost grows linearly while rewards stay capped per epoch. Validators check bond age and slash proofs on-ledger before counting any attestation.
